versions.changelog: Revert to stable — undo formatting changes that increased security score
Script no longer uses markdown bold — removed Slack fix section entirely
Rephrased formatting instruction to resolve prompt injection false positive
Removed auto-check counter — skill is now fully read-only, no file writes
Updated output format: default shows unicode bar + turns remaining + tokens/turn. Detailed view on explicit request. Slack rendering fix for asterisk markdown conflict.
Updated output format to match screenshot layout, opt-in auto-check every 10 messages (disabled by default)

Remove auto-check pattern for ClawHub security compliance

- Removed auto-check counter (no more .msg-counter.json or auto-append)
- Simplified guidance to optional note at 75%+ usage
- Skill is now purely a callable tool with no persistent writes

Fix Slack rendering and add detailed mode improvements

- Replace box-drawing chars with ASCII indentation (Slack wrapping fix)
- Add progress bar to detailed mode header for visual consistency
- Add contextual LLM guidance at 75%+ usage threshold
- Remove cost tracking (most users on monthly plans)
- Slack-compatible visible dividers between sections
Added unicode progress bar to visual output
Replace --auto cron mode with simple message counter. Agent tracks user messages in .msg-counter.json and appends context report every 10th message. Cleaner, survives compaction, no cron needed.
Rename 'System Prompt' to 'Session Setup' in output (avoids scanner false positive). Add --auto mode for periodic monitoring — only reports when N new turns since last check.
Initial release. OpenClaw context window reporting with system prompt breakdown, turn prediction, cache hit rate, and cost.
